items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Mrs. Trevi Poole was a white lady of us dancing school. She gave us our first dance here in Natchez.

ctx.x: He was reading a little, and he got to be a perfect wizard on that side.

And from then, well, he had chased away from home for a while and came back and met lots of musicians, different places, and he looked over the billboard and we would get in. Next was a trombone and there's a trumpet player. And on and, you know, like that, till the band got to about 18 strong. And we never had been out no more than just serenading and playing for little country clubs and little dances like that. Mrs. Trevi Poole was a white lady of us dancing school. She gave us our first dance here in Natchez.…
